episodes.title: Queria muito que você estivesse aqui
episodes.summary: Devastated after his wife's death, an environmental officer is pulled into the mystery of a dead pink river dolphin washed ashore in Rio de Janeiro.

episodes.title: É um caminho sem volta
episodes.summary: Márcia and Eric examine a body found in the forest. Luna sets a trap, hoping to catch Saci. Inês uses her powers on Manaus.

episodes.title: Eles estão entre nós
episodes.summary: While Eric and Márcia investigate Inês, Ivo tries to shut the case. Ciço suggests to Eric that mythical creatures exist. Januária worries about Luna.

episodes.title: A Cuca vai pegar
episodes.summary: In Cedar Forest, Ciço finds a disturbing site. Eric delves into his family's surprising connection to Manaus' case. Inês sends Tutu to do her bidding.

episodes.title: Você não vai acreditar em mim
episodes.summary: With Luna behaving strangely, Januária fetches help from a healer. Unable to remember his encounter with Manaus, Eric gets a memory booster from Ciço.

episodes.title: Coisa de criança
episodes.summary: Luna coaxes Saci to take her to Curupira. Ciço tells Afonso about Dry Body's curse. Eric and friends try to get to Luna before she finds her target.

episodes.title: É muito maior do que a gente
episodes.summary: Inês consoles a guilt-ridden Curupira, while Camila goes after Eric. In the forest, everyone gathers as Eric goes to extremes while battling the curse.

episodes.title: É tudo o que eu mais desejo
episodes.summary: A murder takes place in the heart of the Amazon forest. Luna and Inês embark on a mission to find Eric. Meanwhile, Matinta Perê offers her services.

episodes.title: Não vou te fazer mal
episodes.summary: After removing Bento's curse, Eric uses his new powers to search for Luna. Débora finds a new key to Marangatu and sets up a very private auction.

episodes.title: A vida que a gente sempre quis
episodes.summary: Lazo and Luna become friends while locked up in captivity. Meanwhile, Eric, Clarice and Inês try to invade Débora's secret auction to set them free.

episodes.title: O teu medo é o teu veneno
episodes.summary: While Luna goes through a life-changing healing experience deep within the forest, Eric finds it hard to control his ever-growing powers.

episodes.title: Marangatu, a morada do sagrado
episodes.summary: Débora confronts Castro after learning about her past. Meanwhile, Eric embarks on a painful journey to examine what is developing inside his chest.
